user_question: What is the company's leave policy?
expected_answer:
Here's the company's leave policy:
Types of Leave & Entitlements
Privilege/Annual Leave: 15–21 days per year (accrued monthly)
Sick Leave: 12 days per year (non-cumulative)
Casual Leave: 7 days per year (state-specific)
Maternity Leave: 26 weeks for the first two children; 12 weeks for subsequent children
Paternity Leave: 7–15 days (company policy)
Bereavement Leave: 3–7 days for immediate family
Compensatory Off: For work done on holidays/weekends (requires manager approval)
Public Holidays: 10–14 days per year, based on the company calendar and state notifications
Leave Without Pay: Allowed with approval after exhausting paid leave
Application Process
Apply via the HRMS/leave portal at least 3 days in advance (except for emergencies)
Sick leave exceeding 2 days requires a medical certificate
Emergency leave must be communicated to your manager/HR as soon as possible
All requests require approval from both your reporting manager and HR
You can check your leave balance on the HRMS portal
